ITEM 1 | Pinkish-brown patty about 6 cm across and 2 cm tall, with a seared, browned crust on the outer edges and a slightly pink, moist interior; dense, holds its shape, with thin bright green herb leaves tucked along its right side and top | 110
ITEM 2 | Pale off-white creamy sauce or puree, smooth and slightly glossy, about 4 cm long and 1 cm thick, flowing in a streak beside the other food, with a small piece of magenta-red leaf tip at its left end | 25
ITEM 3 | Irregular rounded piece about 4 cm by 2.5 cm and 1.5 cm tall, golden-tan with a lightly browned, crisp-looking edge and a pale, slightly grainy cut interior; sits under a scatter of small green herb sprigs and thin reddish-purple leaves | 45
ITEM 4 | Small scatter of fresh green herb sprigs and thin bright-green leaves, lying across the patty and the sauce, with a few reddish-purple leaf fragments near the sauce tip; dry, no sheen | 5
